hero-title.purpose: "Crafted Comfort" on the home hero only.

display.purpose: Company names on company-page heroes, max 16ch.

headline.purpose: Section headings and the planner's answer.

title.purpose: Item names in lists and stages; card names over photographs switch to Marcellus 400.

lead.purpose: The one about sentence under a title; the home motto uses this size in Marcellus, in pale brass.

body.purpose: Running text, tabular numerals, prose max 62ch.

label.purpose: Breadcrumbs, key-fact labels, form labels (at 650), notes.

shadows.name: shadow
shadows.purpose: Rest: company tiles, service rows, plate frame, grow tiles, planner result.

shadows.name: shadow-lift
shadows.purpose: Lift: company tiles on hover/focus, key-facts card on the hero foot, contact card.

shadows.name: button-hover
shadows.purpose: Pill buttons on hover, with a 2px rise.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The house curve for reveals, wipes, lifts and header movement.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: Scroll reveals via IntersectionObserver; 0.3s opacity only under reduced motion.

motion.name: rise
motion.purpose: Hero copy plays in on load.

motion.name: wipe
motion.value: clip-path inset 1.1s ease-out, image settle from scale 1.12
motion.purpose: Hero photographs open from the edge; service-row photos wipe from the left over 0.9s.

motion.name: hero-rotation
motion.purpose: Home hero cycles the companies; hover/focus pauses; pause button for touch; off under reduced motion.

motion.name: parallax
motion.value: home hero 0.28, company hero 0.08 of scroll offset
motion.purpose: Set from main.js; disabled under reduced motion.

motion.name: header
motion.value: sticky; tighten after 24px; hide reading down past 320px; 0.4s ease-out

motion.name: read-progress
motion.purpose: Company pages, where supported and motion allowed.

motion.name: view-transition
motion.purpose: Cross-page fades; none under reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Forest-green pill; the default action on ivory.
components.html: Ask about a stay
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 52px; padding: 14px 30px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--accent, #1f4d3a); color: var(--on-accent, #f5efe4); font-family: var(--font, Archivo, sans-serif); font-size: 1.0625rem; font-weight: 650; line-height: 1.2; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 0.18s ease, transform 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn:hover { background: var(--accent-deep, #163a2b); box-shadow: 0 14px 28px -16px rgba(22, 58, 43, 0.6); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn:hover svg { transform: translateX(4px); } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(0.98); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--brass-text, #7d5f2e); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: White Button
components.description: Ivory pill with green text for green fields and photographs.
components.css: .ds-on-green { padding: 24px; background: #1f4d3a; border-radius: 20px; } .ds-btn-white { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 52px; padding: 14px 30px; border-radius: 999px; background: #f5efe4; color: #1f4d3a; font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; font-size: 1.0625rem; font-weight: 650; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 0.18s ease, transform 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-white:hover { background: #cfdccf; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-white:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #d9c29a; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Tone Button
components.description: Sand pill for secondary actions on ivory.
components.css: .ds-btn-tone { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 52px; padding: 14px 30px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--tone, #ebe2d2); color: var(--ink, #1d2a22); font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; font-size: 1.0625rem; font-weight: 650; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 0.18s ease, transform 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-tone:hover { background: var(--accent-tint, #e7dfcf); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-tone:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #7d5f2e; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Planner Chip
components.description: Sand pill radio for the trial-visit planner; fills green when chosen.
components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; } .ds-chip { position: relative; } .ds-chip input { position: absolute; inset: 0; opacity: 0; margin: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip span { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 10px 22px; border-radius: 999px; background: #ebe2d2; color: #1d2a22; font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; font-weight: 650; transition: background-color 0.18s ease, color 0.18s ease, transform 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-chip:hover span { background: #e7dfcf; } .ds-chip input:checked + span { background: #1f4d3a; color: #f5efe4; } .ds-chip:active span { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-chip input:focus-visible + span { outline: 3px solid #1f4d3a; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Contact Field
components.description: Raised-forest field inside the green contact card; pale-brass border on focus.
components.css: .ds-card-green { padding: 32px; border-radius: 28px; background: #1f4d3a; } .ds-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 6px; font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 650; color: #cfdccf; } .ds-input { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; min-height: 52px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(245, 239, 228, 0.16); border-radius: 12px; background: #295a45; color: #f5efe4; font: 1rem Archivo, sans-serif; caret-color: #b08a4f; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #b7cabd; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #d9c29a; }

components.name: Header Navigation
components.description: Archivo 650 links whose underline grows from the left.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 28px; background: #f5efe4; padding: 18px 0; } .ds-nav a { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; color: #1d2a22; font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; font-weight: 650; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 8px; height: 2px; background: #1f4d3a; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-nav a:hover::after, .ds-nav a[aria-current="page"]::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #7d5f2e; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.description: A photograph in a 20px card under the foot veil, Marcellus name and pale-brass call to action.
components.html: Barefoot in the GardenResort, café, cloud kitchen and vendingVisit the page →
components.css: .ds-tile { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: flex-end; width: 320px; height: 300px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 20px; background: #fbf8f2; color: #f5efe4; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px -2px rgba(22, 58, 43, 0.12), 0 24px 48px -28px rgba(22, 58, 43, 0.45); transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 0.3s; } .ds-tile-media { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #6f8f6a, #c9b38a); } .ds-tile-media::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(16, 40, 30, 0) 20%, rgba(16, 40, 30, 0.6) 58%, rgba(16, 40, 30, 0.92) 100%); } .ds-tile-text { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding: 24px; } .ds-tile-name { font-family: Marcellus, Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.75rem; line-height: 1.15; } .ds-tile-what { margin-top: 4px; color: #cfdccf; font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; } .ds-tile-cta { padding-top: 14px; color: #d9c29a; font: 700 0.875rem Archivo, sans-serif; } .ds-tile:hover, .ds-tile:focus-visible { transform: translateY(-6px); box-shadow: 0 4px 10px -4px rgba(22, 58, 43, 0.16), 0 36px 64px -30px rgba(22, 58, 43, 0.55); } .ds-tile:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #7d5f2e; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Key Facts
components.description: Four linen cells split by brass hairlines; rests on the company hero's foot.
components.css: .ds-facts { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 1px; margin: 0; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid rgba(176, 138, 79, 0.35); border-radius: 20px; background: rgba(176, 138, 79, 0.35); box-shadow: 0 4px 10px -4px rgba(22, 58, 43, 0.16), 0 36px 64px -30px rgba(22, 58, 43, 0.55); font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; } .ds-facts > div { background: #fbf8f2; padding: 20px 24px 22px; } .ds-facts dt { font-size: 0.875rem; color: #7d5f2e; } .ds-facts dd { margin: 6px 0 0; font-weight: 650; line-height: 1.35; color: #1d2a22; }

components.html: Loom CraftsOutdoor furniture and prefab cottagesNuts and BerriesBakery and café
components.css: .ds-strip { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 10px; padding: 16px; background: #1d2a22; } .ds-co { position: relative; display: grid; gap: 4px; overflow: hidden; padding: 18px 20px 22px; border: 1px solid rgba(217, 194, 154, 0.28); border-radius: 16px; background: rgba(16, 40, 30, 0.6); color: #f5efe4; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 0.25s ease; } .ds-co:hover, .ds-co:focus-visible, .ds-co.is-on { background: #1f4d3a; } .ds-co:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #d9c29a; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-co-name { font-family: Marcellus, Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.1875rem; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-co-what { font: 0.875rem Archivo, sans-serif; color: #cfdccf; } .ds-co-bar { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; height: 3px; background: #d9c29a; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; } .ds-co.is-on .ds-co-bar { animation: ds-bar 5s linear infinite; } @keyframes ds-bar { to { transform: scaleX(1); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-co-bar { display: none; } }

narrative.northStar: The Resort You Can Buy From
narrative.overview:
Every page arrives the way a guest arrives at Sonapur: a photograph first, full-bleed, under a forest-green veil, with the name set in Marcellus like lettering cut into a brass plate. The furniture and cottages are shown in use, never on a white sweep. The world is warm and unhurried: an ivory ground with sand panels, forest green that takes over whole fields (hero veil, planner result, contact card, partner panel, footer), and brass kept to hairlines, bullets, rules, the motto and focus.

Surfaces are soft and held: pill buttons, photographs and cards rounded at 20px, the larger green cards at 28px, all lifted by low green-tinted shadows rather than grey ones. Motion is slow and courteous: photographs wipe open and settle, the hero rotates through the companies with a timer bar and a pause control, hero photos drift slower than the page, and every travelling effect has a reduced-motion path.

The system refuses two things: the flat company-directory grid the site used to be (square corners, one sans face, a sage ground), and the black-and-gold showroom. Proof is specific and checkable (places, materials, services, a phone number); there are no reviews, ratings or customer counts anywhere.
keyCharacteristics: Photograph first on every page: full-bleed hero under a green veil, then rounded photographs throughout.
Ivory ground, sand panels, forest green owning whole fields, brass only for hairlines and small marks.
Marcellus for the name, display and headings; Archivo for everything people read or press.
Pill buttons, 20px photographs and cards, 28px green cards, soft green-tinted shadows.
Slow reveals and wipes, a rotating hero you can pause, parallax on hero photos, cross-page view transitions.

rules.name: The Brass Is Engraving Rule
rules.body: Brass marks, it never fills. Rules, dots, hairlines, timer bars, the motto and focus rings; never a button, a band or a card. On ivory, words in brass use brass-text; on green, brass-light.

rules.name: The Green Owns The Field Rule
rules.body: Forest green appears as a whole field (veil, card, panel, footer) or as a small accent (link, chip, progress bar), never as a thin decorative tint in between.

rules.name: The Veil Rule
rules.body: Text over a photograph always sits on the forest veil: a left-to-right gradient from rgba(16, 40, 30, 0.78–0.8) to 0.2–0.25, plus a bottom gradient to 0.55–0.6; mosaic tiles use a foot veil from 0 at 20% to 0.92 at the bottom.

rules.name: The Signage Rule
rules.body: Marcellus is for names and headings, always at weight 400; it is never bolded, never used for body copy, labels or buttons.

rules.name: The Five Sizes Rule
rules.body: The ramp is display, heading, lead, body, small, plus the one hero title. Card and panel headings scale the heading clamp down inside their container; they do not introduce a new role.

rules.name: The Green Shadow Rule
rules.body: Every shadow is cast in deep forest (rgba(22, 58, 43, …)) with a long negative spread: a pool under the object, never a hard edge or a grey halo.

dos: Do open every page on a full-bleed photograph under the forest veil, with the name in Marcellus.
Do round photographs and cards at 20px, large green cards at 28px, and make every button and chip a full pill.
Do cast shadows in deep forest with the rest and lift values, and lift on hover.
Do keep brass to rules, dots, hairlines, timer bars, the motto and focus rings; use brass-text for brass words on ivory and pale brass on green.
Do let forest green own a whole field (veil, planner result, contact card, partner panel, footer).
Do say specific, checkable things: places, materials, prices, services and the phone number, set in tabular numerals.
Do give every moving thing a reduced-motion path and every rotating thing a pause.
donts: Don't show reviews, ratings, star marks, customer counts or testimonials; none exist.
Don't return to the flat directory look: square corners, one sans face, a flat sage ground, borders instead of depth.
Don't build a black-and-gold showroom: no black fields, no gold fills, no brass buttons or brass bands.
Don't set Marcellus bold or use it for body text, labels or buttons.
Don't set text directly on a photograph without the forest veil.
Don't use grey or hard offset shadows.
Don't use brass (#b08a4f) for text on ivory; it is below text contrast there.
Don't add marketing superlatives; the photographs and the facts do the persuading.
